subject: [hw] DEC01 -> lead2/dec1: all review items applied (4 HIGH + 8 MED + opus-dec1 M1 data order), N2TEST DEC01 PASS 999/999, probe VD-e with frame displays
body:
Applied every finding; full detail in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC01/STATUS.md and ap/VDEC_FLOW.md.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_dec01/run_tests.sh
  DEC01 asan/o2/tsan PASS 333/333 each; layout 79 lines vs kernel header (32+64-bit); armv7 asserts; arm64-ios compile
  N2VDEC reached VD-b/c/d/e; frames: in=1 displayed=1 (default stream)
  vectors: t320bf0 12/12, t320bf2 12/12, t1080bf0 4/4, t1080bf2 4/4 displayed; HEVC 2 vectors stop at VD-c (named fake need)
  N2TEST DEC01 PASS 999/999

Your items:
H1 planes: planes = job->fb_planes ? : cfg.fb_num_planes (2 for H.264/H.265, 1 for HEIF); probe passes 2 planes; header doc updated.
H2 same-alloc chroma sync: c_handle==handle is the same-alloc marker; the display harvest copies the whole allocation once (test checks from_device +1, separate planes +2).
H3 list_free before list_disp: in_disp/in_free per in-use entry, dropped only when both set; test free2 queues list_free, then a later list_disp, checks the sync still happens and the buffer becomes re-pushable only afterwards; push_fb returns -EBUSY while in flight.
H4 layout: cfg.output_fourcc=N2AP_VDEC_FOURCC_MM21 makes a RES_CHANGE header with another fourcc return -ENOTSUP (test fourcc). Measured answer to your M21S question: it was our old fb_num_planes=1; with 2 planes the small stream is MM21 and 1080p was MT21 only while the property was unset. After V34 landed "0", both buffer forms are MM21 at 320x240 and 1080p (12/12, 4/4). No shim change needed for the client; the probe run uses --require-mm21.
M5 job fb registered before START; -ENOSPC if the table is full; on START error the entry is dropped and the rings harvested anyway; test putstart (PUT inside START, no GET) syncs and displays.
M6 flush harvests regardless of rc.
M7 bounds: same-alloc fb_sz[0]+fb_sz[1] <= allocation; separate c_bytes >= fb_sz[1] and fb_bytes >= fb_sz[0]; too-small test.
M8 bs bounds: length <= size <= registered bytes.
M9 OUT/FREE queues 64 (and FB queue 64).
M10 GET: failed lookup -> index 0xFF/vdec_fb_va 0/proto_error; same-alloc chroma offset; fb_num_planes written; test badfb.
M11 n2ap_vdec_get_pic_info() (display from crop, coded pic, buf, fb_sz[2], fourcc, layout, bitdepth, dpb, changed); test pic.
M12 FRAME_SIZE always sent, 0x0 included; test zero.
LOW: offsets pinned with _Static_assert in mtk_vdec_ipi.h (0x210/0xe20/0x1a30/0x1a40/0x1ac8/0x1af8/0x1b78); header START clears all fb_dma/fb_fd; DMEM bound includes the tail and set_ring_entries is bounded; proto_errors atomic; fb_of/free_fb_count locked; dma copies happen after unlocking; removed the output to_device and the bitstream from_device; irq_clear after a successful WAITISR (test checks the count).
DEC05 M1: data[0]=AU, data[1]=buffer size (kernel names reversed; opus-hevcdec); job fields unchanged.

Also fixed a defect the suite found: close() could free the session while the DEINIT handler was still inside it (ASan use-after-free). A dec_live table + quiesce in close fixes it; test race hammers LOCK/UNLOCK while closing and calls the captured handler with the freed pointer, ASan/UBSan and TSan clean.

Vendor evidence: the probe starts the phone libvpud_vcodec under the A32 interpreter on T02 fake, cycles 4 bitstream buffers + a pool of 2-plane buffers, and displays every frame. To get there I had to keep AP-published ion share ids out of V34's own 0x400+ allocation path (0x501..0x504 lost 3/12 frames with ion_import 0x102; 0x700+/0x800+ is clean). Posted to DEC05/V34. No phone, nothing published.
